description: Brainstorm, PRD, break down into issues, and run parallel execution by role (principal, senior-coder, qa, security, perf, devops, ui-ux).

tg_token.title: Telegram bot token (optional)
tg_token.description: For one-way notifications to your Telegram. Leave empty if unused.

tg_chat.title: Telegram chat ID (optional)
tg_chat.description: Chat ID that receives notifications. Leave empty if unused.

notify.title: Notification driver (optional)
notify.description: telegram (default), orca, or both. Orca marks the workspace unread; Telegram needs a token and chat ID.
